items.title: Louis Armstrong Interview, 1960-08-16
items.q: I used to listen to Sam and Red

ctx.x: well then apparently he didn't learn it anywhere he had it

but it's in him yeah and but the average kid would say I don't want to play that I want to play uh uh uh uh I'm with you on that you know when I was a teenager I listened to the good old greats you know what I mean the boys around my crowd was gonna go to the next neighborhood and fight and all that you know what I mean so I thought they were stupid see I want to hear the elders of people and what they talked about in music and everything like that even when I joined Fletcher Henderson at the Roseland Ballroom I…
working with men that are better than you and I guess there was a time when there was someone better than you when you were awfully young.
